company: Shift AI - Shift Technologies Canada Inc.

addressing user experience issues to ensure responsiveness and accessibility, improve CTAs, and optimize the website's home page loading speed.
writing and publishing a blog on the website to highlight Shift AI's accomplishments.
planning, designing, and implementing prototypes to redesign a website page's contents.
planning, designing and implementing a new page, allowing users to explore and search for hardware devices compatible with the platform.
